_doc: STATE ENTRY REBUILD BUDGET — every record REBUILT BY LITERAL out of an existing one, DECLARED with its class. SINGLE SOURCE, consumed by `test/state-entry-rebuild-gate.test.js` through `src/state-entry-rebuild-pure.js`. DETECTION is NOT here: it lives in `rules/no-rebuilt-state-entry.yml` (ast-grep). Strict separation — the rule detects with zero exemption, this file plus its test carry the POLICY and the RATCHET. Same shape as the quadratic and temporal twins; never invent another one.
_doc_class: THE CLASS IS NOT `this field was forgotten`. It is: REBUILDING A RECORD FIELD BY FIELD SILENTLY DROPS EVERY FIELD ABSENT FROM THE LIST. A literal asserts `here is the whole entry now` — an assertion about fields its author never considered — and nothing goes red: the shape stays valid, the suite stays green, and whatever lived in a dropped field is simply gone.
_doc_paid_twice: PAID TWICE IN THIS REPOSITORY, both under a complete green. ① `src/sources/skill.js`: `skillRules` rebuilt its rule field by field, so the `keys` operator was born INERT on 8 fleet entries out of 8 — with its schema, its validator, 959 green tests and 100 % mutation. ② `src/gate.js`: the foreign-action branch rebuilt a smart doc's entry as `{ seen, sinceLastCall: n + 1 }` and dropped `denied`, the flag that carries the anti-loop `a block is NEVER followed by a block` — so a refused gesture was refused a SECOND time. 28 of 1,024 decisions diverged from the independent model, all in the same direction (engine `deny`, model `allow`), and the three conditions were met in production.
_doc_cure: THE CURE IS THE SPREAD, and it is structural rather than cosmetic: `{ ...entry, field: newValue }` keeps the record's shape OPEN, so a field added tomorrow survives by CONSTRUCTION instead of being born inert. That is why the rule clears an occurrence the moment a spread appears anywhere inside the literal.
_doc_perimeter: 📐 THE PERIMETER WAS CHOSEN BY MEASUREMENT ON 2026-08-23, over 204 tracked JavaScript files, and the wider readings were REFUSED WITH THEIR NUMBERS: any spread-less literal reading a member = 404 hits (a projection is legitimate and dominant — unusable, and a noisy gate gets unplugged, which is worse than none); the same restricted to the right-hand side of ANY assignment = 3 hits, all three false, `module.exports = { ... }` among them; restricted to a SLOT WRITE (the shipped rule) = 0 hits on the repaired repository and exactly 1 on the defect restored. Do not widen without re-measuring.
_doc_blind_spot: DECLARED BLIND SPOT, written rather than hidden: the `skillRules` half of the class (a FRESH `const rule = { pattern, doc }` built out of a source object, then completed field by field) is NOT reachable by AST — it is syntactically identical to the 404 legitimate projections above. That half is sealed by a BEHAVIOURAL judge, `operator-consumption-gate.test.js`, which probes every operator on every dimension. Two halves, two judges, on purpose — never one gate pretending to cover both.
_doc_keys: A BUDGET KEY IS A RELATIVE PATH, NEVER A BASENAME. This repository holds homonyms across `src/`, `src/sources/`, `src/hooks/`, `tools/` and `test/`: two of them melted into one key would make the red NON-ACTIONABLE — one would know a rebuild is undeclared without knowing in WHICH file. Paths use forward slashes on every OS.
_doc_baseline: 📐 BASELINE GENERATED BY MEASUREMENT OF THIS REPOSITORY ON 2026-08-23, after the `src/gate.js` repair: 0 occurrences over a perimeter of 204 tracked JavaScript files, hence an EMPTY `files` map. An empty map is not an unset gate: a file absent from `files` is held at ZERO, so every occurrence written from now on is RED on sight. The recipe is shared across the fleet; the NUMBERS are not — an imported figure would be an INVENTED ratchet, and an invented ratchet protects nothing.
_doc_classes: CLOSED list. `DERIVES_NOTHING` = the literal reads an existing value but the record it replaces genuinely has no other field to carry (proved, not assumed): an act of instruction, so a written `why` is REQUIRED. `DEBT` = a real rebuild knowingly kept: it owes a `why` AND a NUMERIC `impact` naming the fields at risk, because a budget measures QUANTITY and never GRAVITY. `INHERITED_DEBT` = the measurement of the day, EXEMPT from justification ON PURPOSE — nobody has instructed those cases one by one, and demanding a sentence would produce INVENTED ones, which would then make the case look settled. A false justification is worse than none.
_doc_ratchet: The declared `max` must EQUAL the measured count. Measured ABOVE = a new rebuild appeared: propagate the record, or prove the class — 🛑 NEVER raise the `max` to make a push go through. Measured BELOW = a STALE declaration: LOWER IT in the same gesture, otherwise the ground gained is silently taken back by the next writer, who inherits the old ceiling. A declaration with no occurrence left is a DORMANT PERMIT and is RED: that is how an exemption which has stopped being necessary reddens instead of rotting.
_doc_exit: EXIT CONDITION of the whole file: zero entry of any kind. A rebuild leaves the budget by becoming a propagation (`{ ...entry, ... }`), never by widening the ratchet.
_doc_witnesses: ANTI-INERT: one REAL line of code per atom of the rule, DERIVED from the `.yml` — an atom added tomorrow lands in this table by itself and stays RED until someone pairs it with a line whose detection is REQUIRED. 🔴 It is not ceremony: `ast-grep` returns an EMPTY JSON with EXIT 0 on a path it cannot resolve, so a misresolved perimeter is INDISTINGUISHABLE from a clean repository and this gate would be green FOR EVER. A witness for an atom that no longer exists is RED too — a stale witness is an exemption nobody re-reads.
